note: Token-budget ceilings for interactive and scheduled agent runs. Read by a pre-execution gate wrapper for scheduled tasks. Interactive sessions have NO pre-exec gate (the operator is the gate); ceilings there are soft-awareness thresholds recorded to a ledger only. A scheduled run aborts if its projected token cost exceeds the ceiling, or if the day's run count is already at the limit.

interactive.comment: Unlimited by design. The operator is the gate. The ledger records for awareness, not enforcement.

default.comment: Fallback for any scheduled task not explicitly listed below.

consolidation-nightly.comment: The nightly memory-consolidation ('dreaming') job. Higher ceiling, runs once.
